subject: Discovery recap + proposed pilot ops playbook — Lumenova
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@lumenova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed pilot ops playbook — Lumenova

Hi Sofia — thanks again for the call today. Below is a short recap and the pilot ops proposal we discussed so your team can confirm alignment. I kept this focused so it's easy to convert to an M.A.P. if you want to lock dates.

Key pain points you shared
- High false-positive rate on automated categorization in support triage (~28% today), causing manual rework.
- Latency constraints for inference in near-real-time routing (target <= 150ms p95).
- Strict data residency for PII-extracted fields (must remain in their region-controlled S3).

Goals for a 30–45 day pilot
1) Improve categorization precision by >= 12 percentage points on the 6 primary labels.
2) Meet p95 latency <= 150ms for production-like traffic via dedicated capacity profile.
3) Demonstrate secure data handling — private VPC flow, KMS-managed keys, and audit logs.

Proposed pilot scope (what Redwood will deliver)
- Dedicated 2-GPU pilot environment (Redwood Dedicated) with one model variant tuned for classification and a smaller variant for fallback.
- Prompt/eval set: we will run your existing 8k sample set through our eval harness (attached: lumenova_prompt_set.csv).
- Success metrics dashboard: per-label precision/recall, token cost per inference, latency p50/p95, and runbook for failover.

Owners and roles
- Redwood PM: Marissa Cole (marissa@redwood.ai) — overall owner, success metrics, and SOW checkpoints.
- Redwood Infra/Eng lead: Ben Carter (ben@redwood.ai) — infra setup, network, quantization profile.
- Lumenova Lead Eng: Sofia Martinez (sofia@lumenova.com) — data access owner and testing coordinator.
- Lumenova Security: eng-team@lumenova.com — sign-off on access patterns and KMS.

Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): confirm data access and security questionnaire answers.
- Week 1: infra provisioned + model ingestion into dedicated pool.
- Week 2–3: prompt/eval run, iterate model config (2 sprints).
- Week 4–6: acceptance window and analysis; success review and next steps.

Access & setup asks (what we need from Lumenova)
- S3 read-only path for eval set and a 1% live traffic mirror (details in attached runbook).
- Firewall/IP allowlist for two Redwood egress ranges (listed in network_access_guide.md).
- SOC2 questionnaire + contact for any compliance evidence requests.

Attachments (stubs)
- lumenova_poc_runbook_v1.pdf (pilot runbook: steps, IAM roles, rollback plan)
- lumenova_prompt_set.csv (sample prompts + labels)

Next steps (actionable)
1) Sofia: confirm the S3 path and an initial point of contact for security (by EOD Thu).
2) Lumenova eng-team: provide expected test window traffic profile (samples per minute).
3) Redwood (Ben + Marissa): provision the dedicated pool and share access matrix when ready (target: start provisioning by Mon May 10).

If that reads correctly I'm happy to convert this into a mutual action plan (HubSpot) and schedule a short 30-minute kickoff next week to lock owners.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions PM — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: lumenova_poc_runbook_v1.pdf (12 pages) — pilot checklist and sequence
Attachment: lumenova_prompt_set.csv (8,042 rows)
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia@lumenova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lumenova Eng Team <eng-team@lumenova.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed pilot ops playbook — Lumenova

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary and much appreciated. A few clarifying points from our side: 

- Data access: we can provide a read-only S3 path for the eval set today but need to confirm whether the mirror will include PII fields. Our security team prefers redaction before sharing. Can Redwood run the eval on a redacted sample first?
- Latency target: 150ms p95 is acceptable as a goal — can you confirm whether that assumes a regional Dedicated pool (us-west) or multi-region routing?
- Timeline: Week 1 provisioning by May 10 sounds fine, but we have a product release on May 24 that narrows the acceptance window — would you be able to compress the iteration period if initial results are strong?

Quick answers: I will confirm the S3 path by Thursday EOD and loop in our security contact (CC'd). For the mirror, we'll start with a redacted subset and can expand after an initial pass.

Appreciate the attachments. I'll review the runbook and the prompt set with our data team and get back with the traffic profile numbers.

Best,
Sofia
Head of Engineering — Lumenova
sofia@lumenova.com

Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed pilot ops playbook — Lumenova

Sofia — quick technical notes from the infra side after reviewing Marissa's runbook: 

- Latency assumptions: the 150ms p95 target assumes a single-region Dedicated pool in us-west-2 (we'll provide a test region config). Multi-region routing adds ~20–40ms depending on path.
- Redaction: happy to take an initial redacted eval set (no PII). We can also run a separate local-only pass if you want the model to see unredacted content; that would require private deployment or an air-gapped exec.
- Network allowlist: attached a lightweight network_access_guide.md with the minimal ports/IPs we need. If Lumenova avoids NAT for the mirror, it will simplify traceability.

Small ask — can we get the SOC2 questionnaire answers (section 3: data handling + key management) by end of week so we can start KMS provisioning? If your security team prefers to send a single PDF, that's fine.

I'll start the infra ticket and tag it to the provisioning sprint once Sofia confirms the S3 path.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Staff Site Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Thanks Sofia — good notes and the redaction approach makes sense. Quick confirmations and next steps from our side: 

- Redaction: we will run the eval on the redacted sample first. If you later provide a secure unredacted path, we can re-run under a private deployment agreement.
- Latency: Ben confirmed the single-region (us-west-2) assumption. I'll add a brief section to the runbook to clarify p95 assumptions and the small delta for multi-region.
- Compressed iteration: we can accelerate iteration if the initial pass shows >10% uplift after sprint 1. We'll prepare an accelerated cadence plan in the runbook.

Action items we own now
1) Redwood (Ben): open infra ticket and start provisioning once S3 path and SOC2 answers are received.
2) Lumenova (Sofia): share S3 read-only path + security contact (by Thu EOD).
3) Redwood (Marissa): convert this thread into a HubSpot mutual action plan and share the kickoff invite for May 11–13 (30 mins).

I'll publish the MAP and the Doc link here when available. Thanks again — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa

marissa@redwood.ai
